uncomfortable.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
uncomfortable.exZh: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。

unconscious.m: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的
unconscious.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
unconscious.exZh: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。

undertake.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
undertake.exZh: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
undertake.note: 同义词：commence（着手，正式启动）；start（开始，最常用）；词伙：undertake extra listening

undo.ex: I clicked the button to undo my mistake.
undo.exZh: 我点击了按钮来撤销我的错误。

uneasy.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
uneasy.exZh: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。

unkind.ex: He gave an unkind reply to her question.
unkind.exZh: 他对她的问题回答得很不和善。

unsatisfactory.m: adj. 不够好的；不能令人满意的

unstable.ex: The table is unstable and might fall.
unstable.exZh: 这张桌子不稳，可能会倒。

unsuitable.m: adj. 不适宜的；不合适的
unsuitable.ex: This shirt is unsuitable for the cold weather.
unsuitable.exZh: 这件衬衫不适合寒冷的天气。

unwilling.m: adj. 不愿意的；不情愿的
unwilling.ex: He was unwilling to help his friend.
unwilling.exZh: 他不愿意帮助他的朋友。
unwilling.note: 同义词：reluctant（不情愿，勉强为之）；词伙：never unwilling

up-to-date.m: adj. 最新的；最近的；新式的
up-to-date.ex: He keeps his knowledge up-to-date by reading news every day.
up-to-date.exZh: 他每天读新闻来保持知识的更新。

update.m: n. 更新；v. 更新；升级
update.ex: The app sent me a new update.
update.exZh: 应用程序给我发送了一个新更新。
update.note: 词伙：news updates, stay updated on traffic regulations

uphold.ex: The judge will uphold the law.
uphold.note: 词伙：uphold practices, uphold ethical principles, uphold traditional values

upset.m: v. 打乱；使心烦；adj. 难过的
upset.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
upset.exZh: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
upset.note: 同义词：nervous（紧张，心神不宁）；worried（发愁，担忧烦心）

urge.m: v. 力劝；n. 强烈欲望
urge.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
urge.exZh: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。

usual.m: adj. 通常的；寻常的；惯常的
usual.ex: He takes the usual bus to work.
usual.exZh: 他通常坐这路公交车去上班。
usual.note: 同义词：average（寻常，中等平常）；common（常见，普遍有之）；general（一般，总体而论）；词伙：usual walk

vaccinate.m: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
vaccinate.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
vaccinate.exZh: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。

vaccination.m: n. 疫苗接种；预防注射
vaccination.ex: The vaccination took only one minute.
vaccination.exZh: 这次疫苗接种只花了一分钟。

vague.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
vague.exZh: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。

verify.exZh: 请核实你的电子邮件地址。
verify.note: 同义词：authenticate（验证，验明真伪）；certify（认证，出具证明）；confirm（确认，证实无误）；test（检验，实测验证）；词伙：verify answers

vex.ex: The loud noise vexes my little brother.
vex.exZh: 嘈杂的声音让我的小弟弟很烦。
vex.note: 同义词：irritate（惹恼，反复磨人烦）

vibrate.ex: The phone vibrates when it receives a call.
vibrate.exZh: 当手机收到电话时，它会震动。

vicious.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
vicious.exZh: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。

victory.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
victory.exZh: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。

virtue.exZh: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
virtue.note: 词伙：traditional virtues, instill values and virtues

visible.ex: The stars are visible at night.

visual.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
visual.exZh: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
visual.note: 同义词：optical（光学，光学原理）；visible（可见，肉眼看得见）；词伙：visual aids, visual impact, visual stimuli

volatile.m: adj. 不稳定的；变化无常的；adj. 易挥发的
volatile.ex: The alcohol is volatile and evaporates quickly.
volatile.exZh: 酒精是易挥发的，会迅速蒸发。

vow.ex: He made a vow to quit smoking.

vulgar.ex: He used a vulgar word in class.
vulgar.exZh: 他在课堂上说了一个粗俗的词。

waist.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
waist.exZh: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。

weaken.ex: The storm weakened the old bridge.

weary.ex: He looked weary after working all day.
weary.exZh: 他工作了一整天后看起来很疲惫。

weep.ex: Her weeping lasted for hours after the news.
weep.exZh: 听到消息后，她的哭泣持续了数小时。

weird.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
weird.exZh: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。

whirl.m: v. （使）旋转；n. 一连串的事；混乱

whistler.ex: The whistler signaled the start of the game.
whistler.exZh: 吹哨的人示意比赛开始。

wicked.ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
wicked.exZh: 邪恶的女巫对王子施了咒语。

womb.ex: The baby grows in the mother's womb.
womb.exZh: 婴儿在母亲的子宫里成长。

wooden.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
wooden.exZh: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。

worksheet.ex: Helpers will distribute clean worksheets and quickly despatch messages to late teammates.

worksheet.note: 同义词：handout（讲义，分发资料）；词伙：clean worksheet, distribute clean worksheet

worship.ex: The ancient people showed worship to the sun.

wound.m: n. 伤口；创伤；v. 过去式与过去分词词形

yawn.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
yawn.exZh: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。

yearly.m: adj. 每年的；adv. 每年地
